[[File:Ommnibox.png|thumb|right|200px|The bwom pedal was one of two pedals at the base of the omni box.]]
The '''bwom pedal''' was a pedal found at the bottom of an [[Ommni box/Legends|ommni box]] used to adjust the sound of the instrument.
